notes.title: Optimizations & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello hunters and props!

A little summer update with some cool optimizations on most of the maps, some bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements!

Have fun!
Clem

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
*Fixed and optimized all quality settings
*Fixed outline visuals in Low quality
*Fixed Gold and Bronze material to make it look good
*Various UI adjustments

notes.title: v0.4.999 - Bugfixes and improvements
notes.notes:
Many networking improvements have been made
Now private games appear in the game list
Animations and player positions should synchronized better
Fixed a recurrent error where player would stay stuck on the score screen

notes.title: v0.4.993 - Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
- Added an option to leave Voice chat
- Fixed grapple cooldown not working properly
- Fixed Hot/Cold bar UI

notes.title: Hotfix: Text issue for new players
notes.notes: We just released a fix for the text not displaying properly within the game. It's because of the few improvements that we just made in the Language system. It should work now, thank you for your patience!

notes.title: v0.4.8 - New languages + bugfixes!
notes.notes:
We just added many new languages into the game, pickup yours in the Settings!

Patch notes:
- Added Russian, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, and German
- Many bugfixes: "stuck" bug, spectator mode, and grapple exploits
- Improved colliders on all maps

notes.title: Added French + Italian, balancing and bug fixes!
notes.notes:
- Localization: Added French and Italian (thank you so much Plus!)
- Fixed exploits of using grapple through Hunter cage
- Balancing: Now Proxy Meter is disabled by default
- Balancing: Taunts range have been increased
- UI: Bunch of buttons and texts have been adjusted

notes.title: Major Free Update: New map, new props, new skins, and bugfixes!
notes.notes:
- New free map: Dungeon
- New skins: 2 new hunter skins are available in the store, check them out!

- A lot of improvements, fixes and optimizations have been done on all maps

notes.title: Version 0.4.3: New map selection panel + lots of fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello there,

As you know, we are constantly updating and improving the game with new content, features, and fixes.

Here's the list of changes for the 0.4.3 patch:
- New MAP SELECTION panel: We improved the map selection screen to make it more user-friendly and make game settings more visible for everyone. Try to change some game settings for even more chaos!
- MAPS: Fixed many colliders, exploits
- New STORE: We aded many things in the Store, check'em out!
- UI: Fixed many texts and windows issues
- Login Issues: Fixed many issues where players would be stuck on "Connecting to server..."

notes.title: MAJOR Update incoming! Grab your key to play!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are about to release a new map called [b]Midnight Town[/b]! Where spooky things can happen and props could emerge from forgotten worlds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39226759/be1d5938094cc9f1668c408550474a93e840dbe9.jpg[/img]

[h2]The map will only be available for a few days only! Grab a Steam beta key [url=https://discord.gg/YsUJ3d3uJT]on our Discord[/url] and play with us during our daily session at 2PM EST.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39226759/4fee65f9b75e5d47993419a0dd4da6a0632e7d5c.png[/img]

What do we plan next?
We are working full throttle to prepare the upcoming launch of the game and we will keep releasing new content to the beta test version every week so we can gather feedback to make the best game possible (we also love to see your reactions!). Hang out [url=https://discord.gg/YsUJ3d3uJT]on our Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/RunPropRun]Twitter[/url] to stay tuned!

What else did we add in the last few updates?
[list]
[*] [b]PROGRESSION:[/b]Level up and earns new customizations by just playing!
[*] [b]CUSTOMIZATION:[/b] Added Hunter customizations with dozens of skins, hats, mustaches and so much more!
[*] [b]Auto-Taunt:[/b] As a prop, when you stand still, you will taunt every 20sec.
[*] [b]New Decoy Skill:[/b] Make a prop move randomly for 10sec. Use it to draw the attention of a hunter and make your move!
[*] [b]New Speed Boosts[/b] bonus to pickup on the maps: Step on it to give yourself a instant movement speed boost of 100% for 1.5s.
[*] [b]Capture time major change:[/b] length adapted to the size of props: Small 2.5sec / Medium 3sec / Big 3.5sec
[*] PLAYER LIMIT INCREASED TO 12! (Default is still 8)
[/list]

We hope you like what you see! We have many other surprises and new things to show, see ya in game!

Dave & Clem

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.25
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 0.2.25:
[list]
[*] Wall Jump: You now get a slight boost speed when you jump on a wall. Also the direction of the jump is now more accurate.
[*] Smokescreen NERF: Reduced duration of smoke effect by 2 sec
[*] HUGE optimizations done on Bank and Village level
[*] Changed a lot of things under the hood that should improve overall performance
[*] Every maps: Fixed a bunch of colliders that would cause props or hunter to go through the floors, walls, windows, etc.
[*] Improved collider on Hunter and many props
[*] Prepared the game for future exciting updates ;)
[/list]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 1 - New map and new props!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=q8yYr_S4teo;full][/previewyoutube]

Today is a special day, we release our [b]MAJOR UPDATE 1[/b] AND we have a [b]new trailer [/b]!

[h2]This new Major Update includes:[/h2]
- [b]1 new map called VILLAGE[/b]: Set in a medieval theme, new platforming mechanics emerge in this vertical map filled with brand-new funny props

notes.title: New patch!
notes.notes:
Patch notes V0.1.27:

- All maps: Increased colliders size on Hunter's cage to try block the camera and avoid peeking through walls
- PropFarm: You cannot exploit jump to climb on top of the map anymore

Thank you for your bug reports. We are currently working on a new map and new props. Stay tuned! :)

notes.title: New patch v0.1.9!
notes.notes:
Today's patch day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39226759/0f087fb3619ea43a9a8f0742c79498cd96aa8a1c.gif[/img]

Here's the list of things recently added:
[list]
[*] Added in-game Chat
[*] All the interactable objects have now sound effects that everyone can hear. That will help players to know what is going on around them.
[*] New tutorial to help you learn the basics and some pro tips before you start playing
[*] You can now create private games
[*] Added notifications for captures, victories, etc. on the top-right corner of the screen
[*] Bunch of optimizations
[*] Lots of various fixes and tweaks
[/list]

A new map is on its way :) We'll get to the countryside, in a big farm full of fruits, vegetables, but also actionable tractors, water sprayers, and other fun things that will help you escape, hide, and hunt!
